tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search current JoinTheDeal deals: group deals sold by JoinTheDeal and Deal Finder offers found on sellers' own sites (Southern California focus). Filter by keywords, category, event (e.g. black-friday-2026), seller and price range. Returns name, seller, price text as shown by the seller, when it was

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Full details of one deal by its id (from search_deals). Group deals include goal buyers, deal length, what is included, region, payment and tax terms.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories and sellers that currently have deals, with counts, and when the data was last updated.

tools.name: request_group_deal
tools.description: Get the link to JoinTheDeal's group-deal request form for a product the user wants. This tool does not submit anything and takes no personal information: the user opens the link and fills in the form themselves. When enough people ask for the same item, JoinTheDeal asks vendors for a group price.
